CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE market.refresh_org_metrics(IN p_organization_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $procedure$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO market.locality_market_metrics (
    organization_id, locality_id, room_type_label, period_month,
    price_p25, price_median, price_p75, price_avg, property_count, calculated_at
  )
  SELECT
    cp.organization_id,
    cp.locality_id,
    rt.label,
    to_char(now(), 'YYYY-MM'),
    ROUND(percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rt.current_price)::numeric, 0),
    ROUND(percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rt.current_price)::numeric, 0),
    ROUND(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY rt.current_price)::numeric, 0),
    ROUND(AVG(rt.current_price)::numeric, 0),
    COUNT(DISTINCT cp.id)::integer,
    now()
  FROM market.competitor_properties cp
  JOIN market.competitor_room_types rt ON rt.competitor_id = cp.id
  WHERE cp.organization_id = p_organization_id
    AND cp.is_active = true
    AND rt.current_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cp.organization_id, cp.locality_id, rt.label
  ON CONFLICT (organization_id, locality_id, room_type_label, period_month)
  DO UPDATE SET
    price_p25      = EXCLUDED.price_p25,
    price_median   = EXCLUDED.price_median,
    price_p75      = EXCLUDED.price_p75,
    price_avg      = EXCLUDED.price_avg,
    property_count = EXCLUDED.property_count,
    calculated_at  = now();
END;
$procedure$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_bed_occupancy_timeline(p_bed_id uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_now date := current_date;
  v_to  date := least(p_to, current_date);
  v_from date;
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_bed_id is null then return '[]'::jsonb; end if;

  -- Bed availability window start, clamped to p_from.
  select greatest(coalesce(a.start_date, p_from), p_from)
    into v_from
  from beds b join apartments a on a.id = b.apartment_id
  where b.id = p_bed_id;
  v_from := coalesce(v_from, p_from);

  with
  occ as (  -- occupied segments (Staying/On-Notice/Exited), clamped to window
    select greatest(ta.onboarding_date, v_from) as seg_from,
           least(coalesce(ta.actual_exit_date, v_now), v_to) as seg_to,
           ta.tenant_id
    from tenant_allotments ta
    where ta.bed_id = p_bed_id
      and ta.staying_status in ('Staying','On-Notice','Exited')
      and ta.onboarding_date is not null
  ),
  occ_clean as (
    select seg_from, seg_to, tenant_id from occ where seg_to >= seg_from order by seg_from
  ),
  occ_seg as (
    select 'occupied' as state, seg_from as seg_from, seg_to as seg_to,
           (seg_to - seg_from) + 1 as days, tenant_id
    from occ_clean
  ),
  -- vacant gaps = window minus occupied, computed between consecutive occupied segments
  bounds as (
    select seg_from, seg_to,
           lag(seg_to) over (order by seg_from) as prev_to
    from occ_clean
  ),
  gap_mid as (
    select 'vacant' as state, (prev_to + 1) as seg_from, (seg_from - 1) as seg_to,
           (seg_from - 1) - (prev_to + 1) + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    from bounds where prev_to is not null and (seg_from - 1) >= (prev_to + 1)
  ),
  gap_lead as (  -- vacancy before first occupancy
    select 'vacant' as state, v_from as seg_from, (min(seg_from) - 1) as seg_to,
           (min(seg_from) - 1) - v_from + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    from occ_clean having min(seg_from) > v_from
  ),
  gap_trail as ( -- vacancy after last occupancy up to window end
    select 'vacant' as state, (max(seg_to) + 1) as seg_from, v_to as seg_to,
           v_to - (max(seg_to) + 1) + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    from occ_clean having max(seg_to) < v_to
  ),
  all_no_occ as ( -- fully vacant window (no occupancy at all)
    select 'vacant' as state, v_from as seg_from, v_to as seg_to,
           (v_to - v_from) + 1 as days, null::uuid as tenant_id
    where not exists (select 1 from occ_clean) and v_to >= v_from
  ),
  unioned as (
    select * from occ_seg
    union all select * from gap_mid
    union all select * from gap_lead
    union all select * from gap_trail
    union all select * from all_no_occ
  )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'state', state, 'from', seg_from, 'to', seg_to, 'days', days, 'tenant_id', tenant_id
         ) order by seg_from), '[]'::jsonb)
  into result
  from unioned where days > 0;

  return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_occupancy_intelligence(p_org uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_now  date := current_date;
  v_to   date := least(p_to, current_date);   -- never count the future
  result jsonb;
begin
  if p_org is null or p_from is null or v_to is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('window', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', v_to),
      'properties','[]'::jsonb,'apartments','[]'::jsonb,'bedTypes','[]'::jsonb,
      'beds','[]'::jsonb,'monthlyTrend','[]'::jsonb,'heatmap','[]'::jsonb);
  end if;

  with
  live_bed as (
    select b.id as bed_id, b.bed_code, b.apartment_id,
           a.apartment_code, a.property_id, p.property_name,
           (coalesce(b.bed_type::text,'?')
             || case when b.toilet_type is not null then ' ' || b.toilet_type::text else '' end) as bed_type_label,
           greatest(coalesce(a.start_date, p_from), p_from)            as avail_from,
           least(coalesce(a.end_date, v_now), v_to)                    as avail_to
    from beds b
    join apartments a on a.id = b.apartment_id and a.status = 'Live'
    join properties p on p.id = a.property_id
    where b.organization_id = p_org and b.status = 'Live'
  ),
  bed_avail as (
    select lb.*, greatest((avail_to - avail_from) + 1, 0) as available_days
    from live_bed lb
  ),
  -- All stints (full history) for the live beds. occ_from/occ_to are clamped to the bed's
  -- AVAILABILITY window (not just [p_from, v_to]) so occupied can never exceed available.
  stint as (
    select ba.bed_id, ba.apartment_id, ba.property_id,
           ta.tenant_id, ta.staying_status, ta.onboarding_date, ta.actual_exit_date,
           ta.monthly_rental,
           greatest(ta.onboarding_date, ba.avail_from)                 as occ_from,
           least(coalesce(ta.actual_exit_date, v_now), ba.avail_to)    as occ_to
    from tenant_allotments ta
    join bed_avail ba on ba.bed_id = ta.bed_id
    where ta.organization_id = p_org
      and ta.staying_status in ('Staying','On-Notice','Exited')
      and ta.onboarding_date is not null
  ),
  -- Merge overlapping/adjacent occupied intervals per bed (gaps-and-islands) so overlapping
  -- stints are not double-counted. occ_from/occ_to are already clamped to availability.
  occ_ord as (
    select bed_id, occ_from as f, occ_to as t,
           max(occ_to) over (partition by bed_id order by occ_from
                             rows between unbounded preceding and 1 preceding) as prev_max
    from stint
    where occ_to >= occ_from
  ),
  occ_grp as (
    select bed_id, f, t,
           sum(case when prev_max is null or f > prev_max then 1 else 0 end)
             over (partition by bed_id order by f) as g
    from occ_ord
  ),
  occ_merged as (
    select bed_id, min(f) as f, max(t) as t
    from occ_grp group by bed_id, g
  ),
  occ_by_bed as (
    select bed_id, sum((t - f) + 1) as occupied_days
    from occ_merged group by bed_id
  ),
  -- Vacancy fill gaps: gap between a stint's exit and the next stint's onboarding.
  fill_raw as (
    select bed_id,
           onboarding_date - lag(actual_exit_date) over (partition by bed_id order by onboarding_date) as gap
    from stint
  ),
  fill_agg as (
    select bed_id,
           avg(gap)                            filter (where gap > 0) as avg_fill,
           percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by gap) filter (where gap > 0) as median_fill,
           min(gap)                            filter (where gap > 0) as min_fill,
           max(gap)                            filter (where gap > 0) as max_fill
    from fill_raw group by bed_id
  ),
  stay_agg as (
    select bed_id,
           avg(actual_exit_date - onboarding_date) filter (where actual_exit_date is not null) as avg_stay,
           count(*)                                filter (where actual_exit_date is not null) as exited_count
    from stint group by bed_id
  ),
  bed_rent as (
    select distinct on (bed_id) bed_id, coalesce(monthly_rental, 0) as monthly_rental
    from stint order by bed_id, onboarding_date desc
  ),
  status_now as (
    select distinct on (ta.bed_id) ta.bed_id,
           case ta.staying_status
             when 'Staying'  then 'occupied'
             when 'On-Notice' then 'notice'
             when 'Booked'   then 'booked'
             else 'vacant' end as status_now
    from tenant_allotments ta
    where ta.organization_id = p_org
      and ta.staying_status in ('Staying','On-Notice','Booked')
      and (ta.actual_exit_date is null or ta.actual_exit_date >= v_now)
    order by ta.bed_id, ta.onboarding_date desc
  ),
  bed_metric as (
    select ba.bed_id, ba.bed_code, ba.apartment_id, ba.apartment_code, ba.property_id,
           ba.property_name, ba.bed_type_label, ba.available_days,
           coalesce(o.occupied_days,0)                                  as occupied_days,
           greatest(ba.available_days - coalesce(o.occupied_days,0), 0) as vacant_days,
           case when ba.available_days > 0
                then least(round(100.0 * coalesce(o.occupied_days,0) / ba.available_days, 2), 100) else 0 end as occupancy_pct,
           round(f.avg_fill::numeric, 1) as avg_fill, round(f.median_fill::numeric, 1) as median_fill,
           f.min_fill, f.max_fill,
           round(s.avg_stay::numeric, 1) as avg_stay,
           case when ba.available_days > 0
                then round(coalesce(s.exited_count,0)::numeric / ba.available_days * 365, 3) else 0 end as turnover,
           round((coalesce(r.monthly_rental,0) * coalesce(o.occupied_days,0) / 30.0)::numeric, 0) as realized_revenue,
           round((coalesce(r.monthly_rental,0) * ba.available_days / 30.0)::numeric, 0)           as potential_revenue,
           coalesce(sn.status_now, 'vacant') as status_now
    from bed_avail ba
    left join occ_by_bed o using (bed_id)
    left join fill_agg   f using (bed_id)
    left join stay_agg   s using (bed_id)
    left join bed_rent   r using (bed_id)
    left join status_now sn using (bed_id)
  ),
  bed_norm as (
    select bm.*,
           min(occupancy_pct) over () mn_occ,  max(occupancy_pct) over () mx_occ,
           min(avg_fill)      over () mn_fill, max(avg_fill)      over () mx_fill,
           min(avg_stay)      over () mn_stay, max(avg_stay)      over () mx_stay,
           min(turnover)      over () mn_to,   max(turnover)      over () mx_to
    from bed_metric bm
  ),
  bed_score as (
    select bn.*,
      round(
          40 * coalesce((occupancy_pct - mn_occ) / nullif(mx_occ - mn_occ, 0), 0.5)
        + 30 * (1 - coalesce((avg_fill - mn_fill) / nullif(mx_fill - mn_fill, 0), 0.5))
        + 20 * coalesce((avg_stay - mn_stay) / nullif(mx_stay - mn_stay, 0), 0.5)
        + 10 * (1 - coalesce((turnover - mn_to) / nullif(mx_to - mn_to, 0), 0.5))
      , 1) as score
    from bed_norm bn
  ),
  -- Month buckets for trend + heatmap.
  months as (
    select generate_series(date_trunc('month', p_from)::date,
                           date_trunc('month', v_to)::date,
                           interval '1 month')::date as m_start
  ),
  am_avail as (
    select ba.apartment_id, ba.apartment_code, ba.property_id, m.m_start,
           sum(greatest(
             least(ba.avail_to, (m.m_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date)
             - greatest(ba.avail_from, m.m_start) + 1, 0)) as avail_days
    from bed_avail ba cross join months m
    group by 1,2,3,4
  ),
  am_occ as (
    select ba.apartment_id, m.m_start,
           sum(greatest(
             least(om.t, (m.m_start + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date)
             - greatest(om.f, m.m_start) + 1, 0)) as occ_days
    from occ_merged om
    join bed_avail ba on ba.bed_id = om.bed_id
    cross join months m
    group by 1,2
  ),
  heat as (
    select a.apartment_id, a.apartment_code, a.property_id,
           to_char(a.m_start, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
           case when a.avail_days > 0
                then least(round(100.0 * coalesce(o.occ_days,0) / a.avail_days, 1), 100) else 0 end as occupancy_pct
    from am_avail a
    left join am_occ o on o.apartment_id = a.apartment_id and o.m_start = a.m_start
  ),
  trend as (
    select a.property_id, to_char(a.m_start, 'YYYY-MM') as month,
           case when sum(a.avail_days) > 0
                then least(round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(o.occ_days,0)) / sum(a.avail_days), 1), 100) else 0 end as occupancy_pct
    from am_avail a
    left join am_occ o on o.apartment_id = a.apartment_id and o.m_start = a.m_start
    group by a.property_id, a.m_start
  ),
  apt as (
    select apartment_id, max(apartment_code) apartment_code, max(property_id::text)::uuid property_id,
           count(*) total_beds,
           count(*) filter (where status_now in ('occupied','notice')) occupied_beds_now,
           round(avg(occupancy_pct), 2) occupancy_pct,
           round(avg(avg_fill), 1) avg_fill_days,
           round(avg(vacant_days), 1) avg_vacant_days,
           round(avg(turnover), 3) turnover,
           round(avg(avg_stay), 1) avg_stay_days,
           round(avg(score), 1) score
    from bed_score group by apartment_id
  ),
  apt_best as (select distinct on (apartment_id) apartment_id, bed_code from bed_score order by apartment_id, score desc nulls last),
  apt_worst as (select distinct on (apartment_id) apartment_id, bed_code from bed_score order by apartment_id, score asc nulls last),
  apt_lvac as (select distinct on (apartment_id) apartment_id, bed_code from bed_score order by apartment_id, vacant_days desc nulls last),
  prop as (
    select property_id, max(property_name) property_name,
           count(*) total_beds,
           count(*) filter (where status_now in ('occupied','notice')) occupied_beds_now,
           round(avg(occupancy_pct), 2) occupancy_pct,
           round(avg(avg_fill), 1) avg_fill_days,
           round(avg(vacant_days), 1) avg_vacant_days,
           sum(occupied_days) total_tenant_days,
           sum(vacant_days)   total_vacant_days,
           round(avg(turnover), 3) turnover,
           round(avg(avg_stay), 1) avg_stay_days,
           round(avg(score), 1) score
    from bed_score group by property_id
  ),
  prop_hi as (select distinct on (property_id) property_id, apartment_code from apt order by property_id, occupancy_pct desc nulls last),
  prop_lo as (select distinct on (property_id) property_id, apartment_code from apt order by property_id, occupancy_pct asc nulls last),
  prop_best as (select distinct on (property_id) property_id, bed_code from bed_score order by property_id, score desc nulls last),
  prop_worst as (select distinct on (property_id) property_id, bed_code from bed_score order by property_id, score asc nulls last),
  btype as (
    select bed_type_label,
           count(*) total_beds,
           sum(occupied_days) occupied_days,
           sum(vacant_days)   vacant_days,
           case when sum(available_days) > 0
                then least(round(100.0 * sum(occupied_days) / sum(available_days), 2), 100) else 0 end occupancy_pct,
           round(avg(avg_fill), 1) avg_fill_days,
           round(avg(avg_stay), 1) avg_stay_days,
           round(avg(turnover), 3) turnover,
           round(sum(realized_revenue), 0) realized_revenue,
           round(sum(potential_revenue), 0) potential_revenue
    from bed_score group by bed_type_label
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'window', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', v_to),
    'properties', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'property_id', pr.property_id, 'property_name', pr.property_name,
        'total_beds', pr.total_beds, 'occupied_beds_now', pr.occupied_beds_now,
        'occupancy_pct', pr.occupancy_pct, 'avg_fill_days', pr.avg_fill_days,
        'avg_vacant_days', pr.avg_vacant_days, 'total_tenant_days', pr.total_tenant_days,
        'total_vacant_days', pr.total_vacant_days, 'turnover', pr.turnover,
        'avg_stay_days', pr.avg_stay_days, 'score', pr.score,
        'highest_apartment_code', hi.apartment_code, 'lowest_apartment_code', lo.apartment_code,
        'best_bed_code', bb.bed_code, 'worst_bed_code', wb.bed_code
      ) order by pr.occupancy_pct desc)
      from prop pr
      left join prop_hi hi using (property_id) left join prop_lo lo using (property_id)
      left join prop_best bb using (property_id) left join prop_worst wb using (property_id)
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'apartments', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'apartment_id', ap.apartment_id, 'apartment_code', ap.apartment_code, 'property_id', ap.property_id,
        'total_beds', ap.total_beds, 'occupied_beds_now', ap.occupied_beds_now,
        'occupancy_pct', ap.occupancy_pct, 'avg_fill_days', ap.avg_fill_days,
        'avg_vacant_days', ap.avg_vacant_days, 'turnover', ap.turnover,
        'avg_stay_days', ap.avg_stay_days, 'score', ap.score,
        'best_bed_code', ab.bed_code, 'worst_bed_code', aw.bed_code, 'longest_vacant_bed_code', al.bed_code
      ) order by ap.occupancy_pct desc)
      from apt ap
      left join apt_best ab using (apartment_id) left join apt_worst aw using (apartment_id)
      left join apt_lvac al using (apartment_id)
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'bedTypes', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'bed_type_label', t.bed_type_label, 'total_beds', t.total_beds,
        'occupied_days', t.occupied_days, 'vacant_days', t.vacant_days,
        'occupancy_pct', t.occupancy_pct, 'avg_fill_days', t.avg_fill_days,
        'avg_stay_days', t.avg_stay_days, 'turnover', t.turnover,
        'realized_revenue', t.realized_revenue, 'potential_revenue', t.potential_revenue
      ) order by t.occupancy_pct desc) from btype t
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'beds', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'bed_id', bs.bed_id, 'bed_code', bs.bed_code, 'apartment_id', bs.apartment_id,
        'apartment_code', bs.apartment_code, 'property_id', bs.property_id, 'property_name', bs.property_name,
        'bed_type_label', bs.bed_type_label, 'available_days', bs.available_days,
        'occupied_days', bs.occupied_days, 'vacant_days', bs.vacant_days, 'occupancy_pct', bs.occupancy_pct,
        'avg_fill_days', bs.avg_fill, 'median_fill_days', bs.median_fill,
        'min_fill_days', bs.min_fill, 'max_fill_days', bs.max_fill,
        'avg_stay_days', bs.avg_stay, 'turnover', bs.turnover,
        'realized_revenue', bs.realized_revenue, 'potential_revenue', bs.potential_revenue,
        'score', bs.score, 'status_now', bs.status_now
      ) order by bs.score desc) from bed_score bs
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'monthlyTrend', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'property_id', tr.property_id, 'month', tr.month, 'occupancy_pct', tr.occupancy_pct
      ) order by tr.month) from trend tr
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'heatmap', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'apartment_id', h.apartment_id, 'apartment_code', h.apartment_code, 'property_id', h.property_id,
        'month', h.month, 'occupancy_pct', h.occupancy_pct
      ) order by h.apartment_code, h.month) from heat h
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into result;

  return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_trial_balance_detailed(p_org uuid, p_from date, p_to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_id uuid, account_id uuid, code text, name text, account_type account_type, normal_balance normal_balance, parent_id uuid, depth integer, root_code text, root_name text, total_debit numeric, total_credit numeric, balance numeric, cum_total_debit numeric, cum_total_credit numeric, cum_balance numeric, is_active boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH RECURSIVE account_tree AS (
    SELECT a.id, a.organization_id, a.code, a.name, a.account_type,
           a.normal_balance, a.parent_id, a.is_active,
           a.code AS root_code, a.name AS root_name, 0 AS depth
      FROM coa_accounts a
     WHERE a.parent_id IS NULL AND a.organization_id = p_org
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, c.organization_id, c.code, c.name, c.account_type,
           c.normal_balance, c.parent_id, c.is_active,
           t.root_code, t.root_name, t.depth + 1
      FROM coa_accounts c
      JOIN account_tree t ON t.id = c.parent_id
     WHERE c.organization_id = p_org
  ),
  period_balances AS (
    SELECT jl.account_id,
           SUM(jl.debit)  AS total_debit,
           SUM(jl.credit) AS total_credit
      FROM journal_lines jl
      JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
     WHERE jl.organization_id = p_org
       AND je.entry_date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
       AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id)
     GROUP BY jl.account_id
  ),
  cum_balances AS (
    SELECT jl.account_id,
           SUM(jl.debit)  AS total_debit,
           SUM(jl.credit) AS total_credit
      FROM journal_lines jl
      JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
     WHERE jl.organization_id = p_org
       AND je.entry_date <= p_to
       AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id)
     GROUP BY jl.account_id
  )
  SELECT t.organization_id,
         t.id AS account_id,
         t.code, t.name, t.account_type, t.normal_balance,
         t.parent_id, t.depth, t.root_code, t.root_name,
         COALESCE(pb.total_debit, 0)  AS total_debit,
         COALESCE(pb.total_credit, 0) AS total_credit,
         CASE t.normal_balance
           WHEN 'DEBIT'  THEN COALESCE(pb.total_debit, 0)  - COALESCE(pb.total_credit, 0)
           ELSE              COALESCE(pb.total_credit, 0) - COALESCE(pb.total_debit, 0)
         END AS balance,
         COALESCE(cb.total_debit, 0)  AS cum_total_debit,
         COALESCE(cb.total_credit, 0) AS cum_total_credit,
         CASE t.normal_balance
           WHEN 'DEBIT'  THEN COALESCE(cb.total_debit, 0)  - COALESCE(cb.total_credit, 0)
           ELSE              COALESCE(cb.total_credit, 0) - COALESCE(cb.total_debit, 0)
         END AS cum_balance,
         t.is_active
    FROM account_tree t
    LEFT JOIN period_balances pb ON pb.account_id = t.id
    LEFT JOIN cum_balances    cb ON cb.account_id = t.id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_universal_metrics(p_organization_id uuid, p_period text DEFAULT 'current_fy'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_start date;
  v_end date;
  v_today date := current_date;
  v_fy_start_year int;
begin
  -- period window
  if p_period = 'current_month' then
    v_start := date_trunc('month', v_today)::date;
    v_end := (date_trunc('month', v_today) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date;
  elsif p_period = 'last_month' then
    v_start := (date_trunc('month', v_today) - interval '1 month')::date;
    v_end := (date_trunc('month', v_today) - interval '1 day')::date;
  elsif p_period = 'current_fy' then
    v_fy_start_year := case when extract(month from v_today) >= 4 then extract(year from v_today)::int else extract(year from v_today)::int - 1 end;
    v_start := make_date(v_fy_start_year, 4, 1);
    v_end := (make_date(v_fy_start_year + 1, 4, 1) - interval '1 day')::date;
  elsif p_period = 'last_fy' then
    v_fy_start_year := case when extract(month from v_today) >= 4 then extract(year from v_today)::int - 1 else extract(year from v_today)::int - 2 end;
    v_start := make_date(v_fy_start_year, 4, 1);
    v_end := (make_date(v_fy_start_year + 1, 4, 1) - interval '1 day')::date;
  else
    -- fallback
    v_start := date '2000-01-01';
    v_end := date '2099-12-31';
  end if;

  return (
    with t as (
      select status, created_at::date d
      from maintenance_tickets
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
    ),
    t_period as (
      select *
      from t
      where d between v_start and v_end
    ),
    i as (
      select *
      from invoices
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
    ),
    i_period as (
      select *
      from i
      where coalesce((billing_month || '-01')::date, invoice_date::date, created_at::date) between v_start and v_end
    ),
    r as (
      select *
      from receipts
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
    ),
    r_period as (
      select *
      from r
      where payment_date::date between v_start and v_end
    ),
    e_period as (
      select *
      from expenses
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and coalesce(expense_date::date, (billing_month || '-01')::date, created_at::date) between v_start and v_end
    ),
    a_period as (
      select *
      from tenant_adjustments
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and coalesce((billing_month || '-01')::date, adjustment_date::date, created_at::date) between v_start and v_end
    ),
    s_period as (
      select *
      from deposit_settlements
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and coalesce(is_deleted, false) = false
        and status in ('completed','approved')
        and coalesce(settlement_date::date, created_at::date) between v_start and v_end
    ),
    active_allotments as (
      select bed_id, tenant_id, staying_status
      from tenant_allotments
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and staying_status in ('Staying','On-Notice','Booked')
    ),
    live_beds as (
      select id
      from beds
      where organization_id = p_organization_id
        and status = 'Live'
    ),
    bed_state as (
      select
        b.id bed_id,
        exists(select 1 from active_allotments a where a.bed_id = b.id and a.staying_status = 'Staying') as has_staying,
        exists(select 1 from active_allotments a where a.bed_id = b.id and a.staying_status = 'On-Notice') as has_notice,
        exists(select 1 from active_allotments a where a.bed_id = b.id and a.staying_status = 'Booked') as has_booked
      from live_beds b
    ),
    occ as (
      select
        count(*)::int as total,
        count(*) filter (where has_staying)::int as occupied,
        count(*) filter (where (not has_staying) and has_booked)::int as booked,
        count(*) filter (where (not has_staying) and has_notice)::int as notice
      from bed_state
    ),
    adj as (
      select
        coalesce(sum(case when adjustment_type = 'debit_note' then amount else 0 end),0)::numeric as debit_note,
        coalesce(sum(case when adjustment_type = 'credit_note' then amount else 0 end),0)::numeric as credit_note
      from a_period
    )
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'tickets', jsonb_build_object(
        'total', (select count(*)::int from t_period),
        'closed', (select count(*)::int from t_period where status in ('closed','resolved','cancelled','rejected','completed')),
        'open', (select count(*)::int from t_period where status not in ('closed','resolved','cancelled','rejected','completed')),
        'needsTenantApproval', (select count(*)::int from t_period where status = 'pending_tenant_approval'),
        'inProgress', (select count(*)::int from t_period where status = 'in_progress'),
        'waitingCostApproval', (select count(*)::int from t_period where status = 'waiting_for_cost_approval'),
        'assigned', (select count(*)::int from t_period where status = 'assigned')
      ),
      'activeTicketCount', (select count(*)::int from t where status not in ('closed','resolved','cancelled','rejected','completed')),
      'accounting', jsonb_build_object(
        'totalRentalRevenue', (select coalesce(sum(rent_amount),0) from i_period),
        'totalEbCharged', (select coalesce(sum(electricity_amount),0) from i_period),
        'totalOnboardingCharges', (select coalesce(sum(total_amount),0) from i_period where invoice_type = 'onboarding'),
        'totalExitCharges', (select coalesce(sum(total_amount),0) from i_period where invoice_type = 'exit_charge'),
        'totalOtherCharges', (select coalesce(sum(other_charges),0) from i_period),
        'totalInvoiced', (select coalesce(sum(total_amount),0) from i_period),
        'totalCollections', (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from r_period),
        'depositCollections', (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from r_period where receipt_type = 'booking'),
        'totalCollectionsWithoutDeposit',
          (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from r_period) -
          (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from r_period where receipt_type = 'booking'),
        'totalRefundsGiven', (select coalesce(sum(refund_amount),0) from s_period),
        'totalExpenses', (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from e_period),
        'totalPendingCollection',
          (select coalesce(sum(total_amount),0) from i_period) +
          (select debit_note from adj) -
          (select credit_note from adj) -
          (
            (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from r_period) -
            (select coalesce(sum(amount_paid),0) from r_period where receipt_type = 'booking')
          ),
        'totalProfit',
          (select coalesce(sum(total_amount),0) from i_period) -
          (select coalesce(sum(amount),0) from e_period)
      ),
      'tenants', jsonb_build_object(
        'totalUniqueTenants', (select count(distinct tenant_id)::int from active_allotments where tenant_id is not null),
        'activeTenants', (select count(distinct tenant_id)::int from active_allotments where staying_status in ('Staying','On-Notice') and tenant_id is not null),
        'bookedTenants', (select count(distinct tenant_id)::int from active_allotments where staying_status = 'Booked' and tenant_id is not null)
      ),
      'propertyStatus', (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'total', total,
          'occupied', occupied,
          'booked', booked,
          'notice', notice,
          'noticeBooked', 0,
          'vacant', greatest(total - occupied - booked - notice, 0),
          'occupancyPct', case when total > 0 then round((occupied::numeric / total::numeric) * 100)::int else 0 end
        )
        from occ
      )
    )
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_universal_metrics_series(p_organization_id uuid, p_months integer DEFAULT 12)
 RETURNS TABLE(period text, revenue numeric, collections numeric, expenses numeric, pending_dues numeric, deposits_held numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with months as (
    select
      to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM') as period,
      d::date as month_start
    from generate_series(
      date_trunc('month', now())
        - make_interval(months => greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_months, 12), 36)) - 1),
      date_trunc('month', now()),
      interval '1 month'
    ) as d
  ),
  monthly as (
    select
      date_trunc('month', entry_date)::date as month_start,
      sum(signed_amount) filter (where account_code like '4%') as revenue,
      sum(signed_amount) filter (where account_code = '1000' and source_table = 'receipts') as collections,
      sum(signed_amount) filter (where account_code like '5%') as expenses,
      sum(signed_amount) filter (where account_code = '1200') as ar_delta,
      sum(signed_amount) filter (where account_code in ('2100', '2400')) as dep_delta
    from v_account_balances
    where organization_id = p_organization_id
    group by 1
  ),
  cum as (
    select
      month_start,
      revenue,
      collections,
      expenses,
      sum(coalesce(ar_delta, 0)) over (order by month_start) as pending_dues,
      sum(coalesce(dep_delta, 0)) over (order by month_start) as deposits_held
    from monthly
  )
  select
    m.period,
    coalesce(c.revenue, 0) as revenue,
    coalesce(c.collections, 0) as collections,
    coalesce(c.expenses, 0) as expenses,
    -- Balances carry forward through months with no journal activity.
    coalesce((
      select c2.pending_dues from cum c2
      where c2.month_start <= m.month_start
      order by c2.month_start desc limit 1
    ), 0) as pending_dues,
    coalesce((
      select c2.deposits_held from cum c2
      where c2.month_start <= m.month_start
      order by c2.month_start desc limit 1
    ), 0) as deposits_held
  from months m
  left join cum c on c.month_start = m.month_start
  order by m.period;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_universal_metrics_v2(p_organization_id uuid, p_period text DEFAULT 'current_fy'::text, p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_from date; v_to date; v_today date := current_date; v_result jsonb;
    v_revenue numeric; v_expenses numeric; v_owner_rent numeric; v_maintenance numeric;
    v_housekeeping numeric; v_utilities numeric; v_property_ops numeric; v_administrative numeric;
    v_salaries numeric; v_marketing numeric; v_other_exp numeric;
    v_rental_income numeric; v_eb_income numeric; v_guest_stay_income numeric;
    v_onboarding_income numeric; v_late_fees_income numeric; v_exit_charges_income numeric;
    v_collections numeric; v_collections_no_deposit numeric; v_deposit_collections numeric;
    v_refunds_paid numeric; v_outstanding_total numeric; v_advance_total numeric;
    v_deposits_held numeric; v_cash_balance numeric;
    v_active_tenants int;
    v_total_beds int; v_occupied_beds int; v_vacant_beds int;
    v_booked_beds int; v_notice_beds int;
    v_month_filled_days bigint; v_month_possible_days int;
    v_month_occupancy_pct numeric;
    v_month_start date; v_month_end date; v_days_in_month int;
    v_active_tickets int; v_fy_start_year int;
    v_owner_rent_pnl numeric; v_electricity numeric;
BEGIN
    IF p_from IS NOT NULL AND p_to IS NOT NULL THEN
        v_from := p_from;  v_to := p_to;
    ELSE
        IF EXTRACT(MONTH FROM v_today) >= 4 THEN
            v_fy_start_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v_today)::int;
        ELSE
            v_fy_start_year := EXTRACT(YEAR FROM v_today)::int - 1;
        END IF;
        CASE p_period
            WHEN 'today'        THEN v_from := v_today; v_to := v_today;
            WHEN 'this_week'    THEN v_from := DATE_TRUNC('week', v_today)::date; v_to := v_today;
            WHEN 'this_month'   THEN v_from := DATE_TRUNC('month', v_today)::date; v_to := v_today;
            WHEN 'last_month'   THEN v_from := (DATE_TRUNC('month', v_today) - INTERVAL '1 month')::date;
                                     v_to   := (DATE_TRUNC('month', v_today) - INTERVAL '1 day')::date;
            WHEN 'this_quarter' THEN v_from := DATE_TRUNC('quarter', v_today)::date; v_to := v_today;
            WHEN 'this_year'    THEN v_from := DATE_TRUNC('year', v_today)::date; v_to := v_today;
            WHEN 'ytd'          THEN v_from := MAKE_DATE(v_fy_start_year, 4, 1); v_to := v_today;
            WHEN 'current_fy'   THEN v_from := MAKE_DATE(v_fy_start_year, 4, 1); v_to := MAKE_DATE(v_fy_start_year + 1, 3, 31);
            WHEN 'last_fy'      THEN v_from := MAKE_DATE(v_fy_start_year - 1, 4, 1); v_to := MAKE_DATE(v_fy_start_year, 3, 31);
            WHEN 'all_time'     THEN v_from := COALESCE((SELECT MIN(entry_date) FROM journal_entries WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id), v_today - INTERVAL '5 years');
                                     v_to := v_today;
            ELSE v_from := v_today - INTERVAL '90 days'; v_to := v_today;
        END CASE;
    END IF;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue),0), COALESCE(SUM(total_expenses),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(owner_rent),0), COALESCE(SUM(maintenance),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(housekeeping),0), COALESCE(SUM(utilities),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(property_ops),0), COALESCE(SUM(administrative),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(salaries),0), COALESCE(SUM(marketing),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(other_expenses),0), COALESCE(SUM(rental_income),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(electricity_income),0), COALESCE(SUM(guest_stay_income),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(onboarding_income),0), COALESCE(SUM(late_fees_income),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(exit_charges_income),0),
        COALESCE(SUM(electricity),0)
      INTO v_revenue, v_expenses, v_owner_rent, v_maintenance, v_housekeeping,
        v_utilities, v_property_ops, v_administrative, v_salaries, v_marketing,
        v_other_exp, v_rental_income, v_eb_income, v_guest_stay_income,
        v_onboarding_income, v_late_fees_income, v_exit_charges_income, v_electricity
      FROM v_pnl_by_category
     WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id
       AND month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', v_from)::date
       AND month <= DATE_TRUNC('month', v_to)::date;

    v_owner_rent_pnl := v_owner_rent;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(op.escalated_amount), 0) INTO v_owner_rent
      FROM owner_payments op
     WHERE op.organization_id = p_organization_id
       AND op.bill_date IS NOT NULL
       AND op.bill_date >= v_from
       AND op.bill_date <= v_to;
    v_expenses := v_expenses - v_owner_rent_pnl + v_owner_rent;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.debit), 0) INTO v_collections
      FROM journal_lines jl JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
      JOIN coa_accounts ca ON ca.id = jl.account_id
     WHERE jl.organization_id = p_organization_id AND je.source_table = 'receipts'
       AND ca.code IN ('1110', '1120') AND je.entry_date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
       AND jl.debit > 0 AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id);

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit), 0) INTO v_deposit_collections
      FROM journal_lines jl JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
      JOIN coa_accounts ca ON ca.id = jl.account_id
     WHERE jl.organization_id = p_organization_id AND je.source_table = 'receipts'
       AND ca.code = '2100' AND je.entry_date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
       AND jl.credit > 0 AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id);

    v_collections_no_deposit := v_collections - v_deposit_collections;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(jl.credit), 0) INTO v_refunds_paid
      FROM journal_lines jl JOIN journal_entries je ON je.id = jl.journal_entry_id
      JOIN coa_accounts ca ON ca.id = jl.account_id
     WHERE jl.organization_id = p_organization_id AND je.source_table = 'deposit_settlements'
       AND ca.code IN ('1110', '1120') AND je.entry_date BETWEEN v_from AND v_to
       AND jl.credit > 0 AND je.is_reversal_of IS NULL
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM journal_entries r WHERE r.is_reversal_of = je.id);

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(outstanding), 0) INTO v_outstanding_total
      FROM v_outstanding_receivables WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id AND outstanding > 0;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(-outstanding, 0)), 0) INTO v_advance_total
      FROM v_outstanding_receivables WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(deposit_held), 0) INTO v_deposits_held
      FROM v_advance_balances WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;
    SELECT COALESCE(cash_on_hand, 0) INTO v_cash_balance
      FROM v_org_cash_balance WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(active_tenants), 0) INTO v_active_tenants
      FROM v_active_tenants WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id;

    -- ââ Bed counts (matches tenant lifecycle) âââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
    -- A live bed counts as Occupied / Notice / Booked according to the
    -- active allotment's staying_status. Beds with no active allotment are
    -- Vacant.
    WITH live_beds AS (
        SELECT b.id
          FROM beds b
          JOIN apartments a ON a.id = b.apartment_id
         WHERE b.organization_id = p_organization_id
           AND b.status::text = 'Live'
           AND a.status::text = 'Live'
    ), bed_status AS (
        SELECT
            lb.id AS bed_id,
            (
                SELECT al.staying_status
                  FROM tenant_allotments al
                 WHERE al.organization_id = p_organization_id
                   AND al.bed_id = lb.id
                   AND al.staying_status IN ('Staying','On-Notice','Booked')
                 ORDER BY CASE al.staying_status
                            WHEN 'Staying' THEN 1
                            WHEN 'On-Notice' THEN 2
                            WHEN 'Booked' THEN 3
                          END,
                          al.onboarding_date NULLS LAST
                 LIMIT 1
            ) AS status
          FROM live_beds lb
    )
    SELECT
        COUNT(*),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Staying'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'On-Notice'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'Booked'),
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IS NULL)
      INTO v_total_beds, v_occupied_beds, v_notice_beds, v_booked_beds, v_vacant_beds
      FROM bed_status;

    -- ââ Monthly time-weighted occupancy ââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââââ
    v_month_start := DATE_TRUNC('month', v_today)::date;
    v_month_end := (DATE_TRUNC('month', v_today) + INTERVAL '1 month' - INTERVAL '1 day')::date;
    v_days_in_month := (v_month_end - v_month_start)::int + 1;
    v_month_possible_days := v_total_beds * v_days_in_month;

    WITH live_beds AS (
        SELECT b.id
          FROM beds b
          JOIN apartments a ON a.id = b.apartment_id
         WHERE b.organization_id = p_organization_id
           AND b.status::text = 'Live'
           AND a.status::text = 'Live'
    ), month_days AS (
        SELECT generate_series(v_month_start::timestamp, v_month_end::timestamp, INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS d
    ), bed_day_filled AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT lb.id AS bed_id, md.d
          FROM live_beds lb
          CROSS JOIN month_days md
         WHERE EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM tenant_allotments al
              WHERE al.organization_id = p_organization_id
                AND al.bed_id = lb.id
                AND (
                    (al.staying_status = 'Staying'
                        AND al.onboarding_date IS NOT NULL
                        AND al.onboarding_date <= md.d)
                    OR (al.staying_status = 'On-Notice'
                        AND al.onboarding_date IS NOT NULL
                        AND al.onboarding_date <= md.d
                        AND (al.actual_exit_date IS NULL OR al.actual_exit_date >= md.d))
                    OR (al.staying_status = 'Booked'
                        AND COALESCE(al.booking_date, al.onboarding_date) IS NOT NULL
                        AND COALESCE(al.booking_date, al.onboarding_date) <= md.d)
                    OR (al.staying_status = 'Exited'
                        AND al.onboarding_date IS NOT NULL
                        AND al.actual_exit_date IS NOT NULL
                        AND al.onboarding_date <= md.d
                        AND al.actual_exit_date >= md.d)
                )
         )
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_month_filled_days FROM bed_day_filled;

    v_month_occupancy_pct := CASE
        WHEN v_month_possible_days > 0
            THEN ROUND(100.0 * v_month_filled_days / v_month_possible_days, 2)
        ELSE 0
    END;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_active_tickets FROM maintenance_tickets
     WHERE organization_id = p_organization_id
       AND status NOT IN ('closed','resolved','completed','cancelled');

    v_result := jsonb_build_object(
        'period', jsonb_build_object('from', v_from, 'to', v_to, 'preset', p_period),
        'accounting', jsonb_build_object(
            'totalRevenue', v_revenue,
            'totalRentalRevenue', v_rental_income,
            'totalEbCharged', v_eb_income,
            'totalGuestStay', v_guest_stay_income,
            'totalOnboardingCharges', v_onboarding_income,
            'totalLateFees', v_late_fees_income,
            'totalExitCharges', v_exit_charges_income,
            'totalExpenses', v_expenses,
            'expenseBreakdown', jsonb_build_object(
                'ownerRent', v_owner_rent, 'electricity', v_electricity, 'maintenance', v_maintenance,
                'housekeeping', v_housekeeping, 'utilities', v_utilities,
                'propertyOps', v_property_ops, 'administrative', v_administrative,
                'salaries', v_salaries, 'marketing', v_marketing, 'other', v_other_exp
            ),
            'totalProfit', v_revenue - v_expenses,
            'profitMarginPct', ROUND(100.0 * (v_revenue - v_expenses) / NULLIF(v_revenue, 0), 2),
            'totalCollections', v_collections,
            'totalCollectionsWithoutDeposit', v_collections_no_deposit,
            'depositCollections', v_deposit_collections,
            'totalRefundsGiven', v_refunds_paid,
            'totalPendingCollection', v_outstanding_total,
            'totalAdvanceBalance', v_advance_total,
            'totalDepositsHeld', v_deposits_held,
            'cashBalance', v_cash_balance
        ),
        'tenants', jsonb_build_object('activeTenants', v_active_tenants),
        'propertyStatus', jsonb_build_object(
            'total', v_total_beds,
            'occupied', v_occupied_beds,
            'notice', v_notice_beds,
            'booked', v_booked_beds,
            'vacant', v_vacant_beds,
            'occupancyPct', ROUND(100.0 * (v_occupied_beds + v_notice_beds) / NULLIF(v_total_beds, 0), 2),
            'monthOccupancyPct', v_month_occupancy_pct,
            'monthFilledBedDays', v_month_filled_days,
            'monthPossibleBedDays', v_month_possible_days,
            'monthDays', v_days_in_month
        ),
        'tickets', jsonb_build_object('activeCount', v_active_tickets),
        'meta', jsonb_build_object('source','journal_v2','computed_at', now())
    );
    RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.log_journal_entry_post()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_total_debit  numeric;
    v_total_credit numeric;
BEGIN
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit), 0), COALESCE(SUM(credit), 0)
      INTO v_total_debit, v_total_credit
      FROM journal_lines WHERE journal_entry_id = NEW.id;

    INSERT INTO financial_audit_log (
        organization_id, journal_entry_id, operation, actor_user_id,
        source_table, source_id, period, total_debit, total_credit, metadata
    ) VALUES (
        NEW.organization_id, NEW.id,
        CASE WHEN NEW.is_reversal_of IS NOT NULL THEN 'REVERSAL' ELSE 'POST' END,
        auth.uid(),
        NEW.source_table, NEW.source_id, NEW.period,
        v_total_debit, v_total_credit,
        NEW.metadata
    );
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.replace_invoices_atomic(p_org_id uuid, p_billing_month text, p_allotment_ids uuid[], p_invoices jsonb, p_line_items jsonb, p_eb_shares jsonb, p_replacement_targets jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_existing_ids uuid[];
  v_inserted_ids uuid[];
  v_inv jsonb;
  v_new_id uuid;
  v_li jsonb;
  v_es jsonb;
  v_inv_index int;
BEGIN
  -- Validate inputs
  IF p_allotment_ids IS NULL OR array_length(p_allotment_ids, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'allotment_ids must be a non-empty array';
  END IF;

  -- Step 1: Find existing invoice IDs scoped to the given allotments + optional invoice_type
  IF p_replacement_targets IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(p_replacement_targets) > 0 THEN
    -- Precise deletion: only delete invoices matching (allotment_id, invoice_type) pairs
    SELECT array_agg(i.id) INTO v_existing_ids
    FROM invoices i
    INNER JOIN jsonb_to_recordset(p_replacement_targets) AS t(allotment_id uuid, invoice_type text)
      ON i.allotment_id = t.allotment_id
      AND COALESCE(i.invoice_type, 'regular') = t.invoice_type
    WHERE i.organization_id = p_org_id
      AND i.billing_month = p_billing_month
      AND i.is_deleted = false;
  ELSE
    -- Fallback: delete all invoices for the given allotments (backward compatible)
    SELECT array_agg(id) INTO v_existing_ids
    FROM invoices
    WHERE organization_id = p_org_id
      AND billing_month = p_billing_month
      AND is_deleted = false
      AND allotment_id = ANY(p_allotment_ids);
  END IF;

  -- Step 2: Delete related records then invoices (all in this transaction)
  IF v_existing_ids IS NOT NULL AND array_length(v_existing_ids, 1) > 0 THEN
    DELETE FROM invoice_line_items WHERE invoice_id = ANY(v_existing_ids);
    DELETE FROM eb_tenant_shares WHERE invoice_id = ANY(v_existing_ids);
    DELETE FROM invoices WHERE id = ANY(v_existing_ids);
  END IF;

  -- Step 3: Insert new invoices and collect their IDs in order
  v_inserted_ids := ARRAY[]::uuid[];
  FOR v_inv IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_invoices)
  LOOP
    INSERT INTO invoices (
      organization_id, tenant_id, property_id, apartment_id, bed_id,
      allotment_id, invoice_number, billing_month, rent_amount,
      electricity_amount, estimated_eb, late_fee, other_charges,
      total_amount, invoice_date, due_date, status, balance, amount_paid, invoice_type, is_deleted
    ) VALUES (
      (v_inv->>'organization_id')::uuid,
      (v_inv->>'tenant_id')::uuid,
      (v_inv->>'property_id')::uuid,
      (v_inv->>'apartment_id')::uuid,
      (v_inv->>'bed_id')::uuid,
      (v_inv->>'allotment_id')::uuid,
      v_inv->>'invoice_number',
      v_inv->>'billing_month',
      (v_inv->>'rent_amount')::numeric,
      (v_inv->>'electricity_amount')::numeric,
      COALESCE((v_inv->>'estimated_eb')::numeric, 0),
      (v_inv->>'late_fee')::numeric,
      (v_inv->>'other_charges')::numeric,
      (v_inv->>'total_amount')::numeric,
      (v_inv->>'invoice_date')::date,
      (v_inv->>'due_date')::date,
      COALESCE(v_inv->>'status', 'pending'),
      (v_inv->>'balance')::numeric,
      COALESCE((v_inv->>'amount_paid')::numeric, 0),
      COALESCE(v_inv->>'invoice_type', 'regular'),
      false
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id;
    v_inserted_ids := array_append(v_inserted_ids, v_new_id);
  END LOOP;

  -- Step 4: Insert line items using invoice_index to resolve invoice_id
  IF p_line_items IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(p_line_items) > 0 THEN
    FOR v_li IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_line_items)
    LOOP
      v_inv_index := (v_li->>'invoice_index')::int;
      INSERT INTO invoice_line_items (
        invoice_id, organization_id, line_type, description, amount, metadata
      ) VALUES (
        v_inserted_ids[v_inv_index + 1],
        p_org_id,
        v_li->>'line_type',
        v_li->>'description',
        (v_li->>'amount')::numeric,
        COALESCE(v_li->'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)
      );
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  -- Step 5: Insert EB shares using invoice_index to resolve invoice_id
  IF p_eb_shares IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(p_eb_shares) > 0 THEN
    FOR v_es IN SELECT * FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_eb_shares)
    LOOP
      v_inv_index := (v_es->>'invoice_index')::int;
      INSERT INTO eb_tenant_shares (
        invoice_id, organization_id, apartment_id, billing_month,
        total_apartment_bill, total_tenant_days, per_day_rate,
        tenant_stay_days, tenant_eb_charge, total_units, unit_cost
      ) VALUES (
        v_inserted_ids[v_inv_index + 1],
        p_org_id,
        (v_es->>'apartment_id')::uuid,
        v_es->>'billing_month',
        (v_es->>'total_apartment_bill')::numeric,
        (v_es->>'total_tenant_days')::int,
        (v_es->>'per_day_rate')::numeric,
        (v_es->>'tenant_stay_days')::int,
        (v_es->>'tenant_eb_charge')::numeric,
        (v_es->>'total_units')::numeric,
        (v_es->>'unit_cost')::numeric
      );
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'count', array_length(v_inserted_ids, 1),
    'invoice_ids', to_jsonb(v_inserted_ids),
    'deleted_count', COALESCE(array_length(v_existing_ids, 1), 0)
  );
END;
